request.text:
labels: A clear tear bead sits at the lower eyelid and a narrow wet trace runs down the cheek, reflecting the same light as the adjacent skin.; 맑은 눈물 방울이 아래 눈꺼풀에 놓이고 가는 젖은 자국이 볼을 따라 내려가며 주변 피부와 같은 빛을 반사한다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A clear tear bead sits at the lower eyelid and a narrow wet trace runs down the cheek, reflecting the same light as the adjacent skin.
aliases: 실제 눈물의 접촉 경로
